risk_summary: The excerpt is generally quantified and transparent on revenue, margins, operating loss, R&D spending, cash flows, and credit-facility compliance, but it includes substantial standard forward-looking disclaimers and promotional positioning. Operating performance weakened in 2024, with lower revenue, reduced gross margin, a shift to an operating loss, increased R&D costs, and significant cash use for share repurchases and investment. Liquidity appears supported by cash generation and an undrawn facility, although future growth depends on regulatory approvals, product development, and execution…
